title: Talent Acquisition Specialist-Associate
description:
Operational Workforce Planning & Acquisition; Strategic operational workforce planning (CE, Ops, Sales), High-volume recruitment and hiring / RPO

Grade - 9

**What you will do**

We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented **Talent Acquisition Associate** to manage the end-to-end recruitment process. The ideal candidate will be responsible for sourcing, screening, interviewing, and hiring qualified candidates while building a strong talent pipeline and delivering an excellent candidate experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the **end-to-end recruitment cycle**, from requirement gathering to offer closure and onboarding.
* Stakeholder management - Partner with hiring managers to understand job requirements, skills, and team fit.
* Source candidates through **job portals, LinkedIn, social media, employee referrals, databases, and other channels**.
* Screen resumes and conduct initial candidate assessments/interviews.
* Coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring teams.
* Manage candidate communication and ensure a positive candidate experience.
* Negotiate offers and support candidates through the joining process.
* Maintain and regularly update the recruitment pipeline and candidate database.
* Track recruitment metrics such as **time-to-hire, source effectiveness, offer-to-joining ratio, and hiring performance**.
* Develop and maintain talent pools for current and future hiring requirements.
* Support employer branding and recruitment marketing initiatives.
* Ensure recruitment activities comply with company policies and applicable employment regulations.

**You will be a great fit if you**

  

* Bachelors degree in **HR, Business Administration, or a related field**.
* 3-5 years of experience in Talent Acquisition / Recruitment is mandatory.
* Strong knowledge of sourcing and recruitment techniques.
* Hands-on experience with **LinkedIn, job portals, ATS, and recruitment databases**.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong negotiation, stakeholder-management, and coordination abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple positions and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong attention to detail and follow-through.

Analytical Skills; Planning & Organization Skills; Written & Verbal Communication Skills; Influencing & Persuasion Skills; Project Management Skills

FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

**Our Company**
---------------

FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.

**Our Philosophy**
------------------

The People-Service-Profit philosophy (P-S-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People-Service-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well-being, and value their contributions to the company.

**Our Culture**
---------------

Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

title: Senior Technical Specialist - MS Network
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**  
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Your day at NTT DATA**  
As a Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L4) at NTT DATA, you will ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational by proactively managing, overseeing, and resolving escalated technical incidents. Your day will revolve around reviewing client requests or tickets and leveraging your technical knowledge to provide immediate and permanent resolutions, all while maintaining adherence to our service level agreements (SLAs).  
  
Working across two or more technology domains such as Cloud, Security, Networking, Applications, or Collaboration, you'll provide fourth-line support for complex issues that lower-level teams couldn't resolve. Your role involves investigating issues in advance, documenting your solutions, and sharing insights to empower other engineers.  
  
You'll play an integral role in ensuring that contracted Managed Services outcomes are delivered to clients promptly, participating in change implementation tracking, and communicating effectively with other teams and clients. As an emergency support contact, you'll be essential for critical client and business-impacting issues.  
  
In addition to addressing escalated incidents, you'll contribute to, and support project work as needed, optimizing DATA storage and implementing disaster recovery functions. By continuously updating and improving our processes, you'll help us drive automation and efficiency across our operations.

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Deep technical skills in relevant functions and a passion for exceeding client expectations.
* Advanced Managed Services experience handling complex cross-technology infrastructure.
* Familiarity with ticketing tools like ServiceNow and extensive vendor management experience.
* Advanced experience in multiple technology domains and an understanding of IT industry standards and emerging trends.
* Excellent change management skills, capable of planning and executing changes with clear risk identification and mitigation.
* Proficiency in listening techniques and client-focused interaction to ensure a positive client journey.
* Ability to communicate and work effectively across different cultures and social groups.
* Resilience under pressure and a positive outlook at work.
* A bachelor's degree in IT/Computing or equivalent work experience.

**Workplace type****:**

On-site Working

**About NTT DATA**  
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune

Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through

responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with

unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and

application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move

confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more

than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as

established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each

year in R&D.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**  
NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

**Third parties fraudulently posing as NTT DATA recruiters**

NTT DATA recruiters will never ask job seekers or candidates for payment or banking information during the recruitment process, for any reason. title: Immediate hiring for Supply Chain Manager
description:
PP Consumer Pvt. Ltd. (Dr. Rashel) is looking for an experienced and result-oriented **Supply Chain Manager** to manage end-to-end supply chain operations, including procurement, vendor management, packaging, inventory planning, order fulfilment, and logistics coordination.

The ideal candidate should have experience in FMCG, beauty, skincare, cosmetics, personal care, or related industries, with a strong understanding of private-label manufacturing, packaging procurement, and supply planning across General Trade (GT), Modern Trade (MT), wholesale, and e-commerce channels.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring product availability, optimising inventory levels, controlling procurement costs, and maintaining timely delivery across all business channels.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Procurement & Vendor Management**

* Identify, evaluate, and develop reliable suppliers and manufacturers.
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, quality standards, and delivery schedules.
* Manage procurement of finished goods, raw materials, and packaging materials.
* Build strong vendor relationships and maintain an updated vendor database.
* Monitor supplier performance against agreed cost, quality, and delivery parameters.

**2. Private-Label Manufacturing & Packaging**

* Coordinate with third-party manufacturers for product planning and manufacturing schedules.
* Manage packaging procurement, including bottles, jars, tubes, cartons, labels, and other packaging components.
* Coordinate Bill of Materials (BOM), packaging specifications, and product requirements.
* Ensure material availability to avoid production and dispatch delays.

**3. Inventory & Demand Planning**

* Coordinate with sales, marketing, and e-commerce teams to forecast demand.
* Maintain optimum inventory levels and avoid stockouts and excess inventory.
* Monitor stock ageing, slow-moving items, and near-expiry products.
* Prepare inventory reports and ensure accurate stock planning.

**4. Order Fulfilment & Logistics**

* Ensure timely order processing and dispatch across GT, MT, wholesale, and e-commerce channels.
* Coordinate with warehouses, transporters, suppliers, and internal teams.
* Monitor delivery timelines and service-level agreements (SLAs).
* Track On-Time In-Full (OTIF) performance and resolve fulfilment issues.

**5. Cost Optimisation & Reporting**

* Identify opportunities to reduce procurement, packaging, warehousing, and logistics costs.
* Prepare MIS reports on inventory, procurement, vendor performance, and order fulfilment.
* Track key supply chain performance indicators and implement corrective actions.
* Develop standard operating procedures to improve operational efficiency.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 5–8 years of relevant experience in supply chain, procurement, or operations.
* Experience in FMCG, cosmetics, skincare, beauty, personal care, or private-label manufacturing is preferred.
* Strong vendor negotiation, sourcing, and cost-control skills.
* Knowledge of inventory management, demand planning, BOM, procurement processes, and logistics.
* Experience coordinating with third-party manufacturers and packaging suppliers.
* Good analytical, problem-solving, communication, and coordination skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and ERP or inventory management systems.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

We are looking for a hands-on professional who can manage multiple suppliers, coordinate with internal departments, solve operational challenges, and build an efficient and scalable supply chain process.

Candidates with experience managing multiple sales channels and working with third-party manufacturers in the beauty, cosmetics, or personal-care industry will be preferred.

Pay: ₹1,200,000.00 - ₹1,500,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Application Support Senior Analyst - Assistant Vice President
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Role Overview**

The **L2 Application Support Engineer** (Technical Support Analyst) is a critical role within the Production Support and Operations team. This individual is responsible for providing high-quality technical support, troubleshooting, and incident resolution for complex enterprise applications and platforms. Acting as the bridge between L1 Helpdesk/Monitoring teams and L3 Development/Engineering groups, the L2 Engineer ensures system availability, stability, and adherence to strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs) in a fast-paced, enterprise technology environment.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Incident & Problem Management**

* **Escalation Handling:** Acknowledge and own incidents escalated by the L1 support team or monitoring alerts.
* **Troubleshooting & Diagnosis:** Perform in-depth technical analysis and root cause investigation of application, database, middleware, and infrastructure failures.
* **Workaround Implementation:** Apply approved temporary workarounds or permanent hotfixes to restore services quickly and minimize business impact.
* **Collaboration:** Partner with L3 developers, database administrators (DBAs), network engineers, and system administrators to resolve complex, multi-tiered issues.
* **Incident Lifecycle Management:** Track and document all incident progression within the ITSM platform (e.g., ServiceNow) from creation through to resolution.
  

  

**2. Monitoring, Observability & Preventive Maintenance**

* **System Monitoring:** Actively monitor application health, batch jobs, integration feeds, and system performance using enterprise observability suites.
* **Proactive Interventions:** Identify recurring patterns, error trends, or capacity bottlenecks and initiate preventative actions.
* **Health Checks:** Perform daily health checks, start-of-day (SOD) and end-of-day (EOD) verifications, and batch processing runs.

**3. Release, Deployment & Configuration Management**

* **Deployment Validation:** Support the verification of application deployments, system patches, and infrastructure upgrades during maintenance windows.
* **Configuration Controls:** Maintain and update application configuration files, environment variables, and parameter settings under strict change management processes.
* **Environment Management:** Assist in maintaining non-production (UAT/Staging) and production environments to ensure consistency.

**4. Communication & Stakeholder Management**

* **Status Updates:** Provide clear, timely, and precise communications to business stakeholders, product owners, and technology leadership during critical (Sev-1/Sev-2) incidents.
* **Bridges & War Rooms:** Participate in or lead technical incident bridges to coordinate restoration efforts.
* **Post-Incident Reviews:** Contribute technical inputs to Post-Incident Reviews (PIRs) and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documentation.

**5. Documentation & Knowledge Management**

* **Runbooks & SOPs:** Document and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), application architecture maps, and troubleshooting runbooks.
* **Knowledge Sharing:** Train L1 teams on common issue resolution paths to shift-left workloads and improve first-contact resolution rates.

**Qualifications & Experience**

  
  

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* **Experience:** 8+ years of experience in an application support, technical support, or systems engineering role (preferably in an enterprise or financial services environment).
* **Certifications (Desirable):**
  + ITIL v3 or v4 Foundation certification.
  + Professional certifications in AWS/Azure, Kubernetes (CKAD), Linux Administration, or Oracle/SQL.

**Required Technical Skills**

**Domain**

**Technology / Tooling**

**Operating Systems**

Strong hands-on experience with **Linux/Unix** environments (navigating file systems, checking logs, monitoring CPU/memory, cron jobs) and **Windows Server**.

**Scripting & Automation**

Proficiency in writing and debugging **Shell scripting** (Bash), **PowerShell**, or **Python** to automate daily tasks and analyze log files.

**Databases & Querying**

Strong **SQL** skills (Oracle, MS SQL, Sybase, or PostgreSQL). Ability to write complex select queries, joins, analyze execution plans, and run database scripts.

**Middleware & Web Servers**

Working knowledge of **Apache**, **Tomcat**, **Nginx**, **WebSphere,** and messaging queues like **IBM MQ**, **RabbitMQ**, or **Apache Kafka**.

**Cloud & Containerization**

Familiarity with **Docker**, **Kubernetes**, **OpenShift**, or cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure) concepts and container deployments.

**Monitoring & Logging**

Hands-on experience with tools such as **Splunk**, **ELK Stack**, **AppDynamics**, **Dynatrace**, **Grafana**, or **ITRS Geneos**.

**ITSM & Collaboration**

Experience with ticketing tools like **ServiceNow** or **Jira**, and version control systems like **Git** or Bitbucket.

  
  

**Required Professional & Soft Skills**

* **Analytical Mindset:** Excellent logical reasoning and problem-solving skills; ability to systematically break down a complex issue.
* **Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate technical details into plain language for business teams.
* **Pressure Tolerance:** Calm demeanor under pressure, especially during high-severity system outages.
* **Team Collaboration:** Ability to work cohesively in a global, distributed cross-functional environment.

title: Associate - Talent Acquisition Specialist – US Hiring
description:
The Specialist Recruiter, Global Talent Acquisition job performs a variety of professional and administrative recruiting functions in support of identifying, interviewing, evaluating, and selecting qualified employees to effectively meet the organization's staffing requirements. Under general supervision, this job is responsible for promoting the organization's image as a desirable place to work and attracting and recommending placement of internal and external candidates for entry\-level and experienced positions.
  

  

**Key Responsibilities and Duties*** Refers applicants for particular job openings, administers pre\-employment tests, checks references, and conducts exit interviews.
* Determines best avenue in recruiting (e.g., advertising, direct contact, employee referrals, research organizations, employment agencies, and job fairs).
* Contacts candidates, schedule interviews, and develop interview questions in with the hiring manager so interviews are conducted efficiently and equitably.
* Prepares job postings, specifications for recruitment agencies, job descriptions and other materials in accordance with the organization's recruitment standards.
* Represents the organization at job fairs to promote the organization to potential candidates.
* Responds to inquiries about the organization's recruitment activities and status of job vacancies.
* Concludes recruitment process by closing the recruitment requisition and advising unsuccessful candidates in an accurate, timely and compliant manner.

**Educational Requirements*** University (Degree) Preferred

**Work Experience*** 2\+ Years Required; 3\+ Years Preferred

**Physical Requirements*** Physical Requirements: Sedentary Work

  

**Career Level**  

6IC  

  

**Required Skills:**

* 6\+ years of full recruitment lifecycle experience in US markets.
* Expert\-level knowledge of LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, and Boolean/X\-Ray search techniques.
* Hands\-on experience with Workday or similar ATS platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to manage high\-volume, fast\-paced recruitment successfully.
* Ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.
* Understanding of or experience with AI\-powered recruitment tools.
* Experience recruiting for financial services, Wealth Management, or FinTech sectors.
* Strong understanding of US visa types (H1B, EAD, GC, Citizens).
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced, high\-pressure environment.
* Advance Excel skills.
* Willingness to work night shifts (US business hours).
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Related Skills
Business Acumen, Communication, Digital Savviness, Employer Branding, Labor Laws, Market/Industry Dynamics, Story Telling, Talent Acquisition/Sourcing

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. TIAA does not discriminate against any candidate or employee on the basis of age, race, color, national origin, sex, religion, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other legally protected status.

title: Senior MS Engineer – Network Security
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**  

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Your day at NTT DATA**  

As a Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L2\) at NTT DATA, you will play an essential role in maintaining our clients' IT infrastructure and systems. Your expertise will help keep everything running smoothly by proactively monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems. You'll be the go\-to person to restore services and ensure our clients' satisfaction.  

  

Your typical day involves managing work queues, addressing incidents and requests within agreed SLAs, and updating tickets with the actions taken. By identifying, analysing, and logging issues before they escalate, you'll be instrumental in maintaining service quality. You'll also collaborate closely with other teams and clients to provide second\-level support, ensuring seamless communication and efficient problem resolution.  

  

You will execute changes meticulously, understanding and mitigating risks, and contribute to the change management process with detailed documentation. Your role includes auditing incident and request tickets for quality, recommending improvements, and identifying tasks for automation to enhance efficiency. Additionally, you'll handle client escalations with professionalism and assist in disaster recovery functions and tests when necessary.  

  

Working within our diverse and inclusive environment, you'll help drive the optimization of efforts by working with automation teams and supporting L1 Engineers. Your responsibility also extends to contributing to various projects, ensuring that all changes are approved, and maintaining a positive outlook even in high\-pressure situations.  

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:*** Moderate\-level experience in managed services roles handling cross\-technology infrastructure.
* Knowledge of ticketing tools, preferably ServiceNow.
* Familiarity with ITIL processes and experience working with vendors and third parties.
* Proficiency in planning activities and projects, taking changing circumstances into account.
* Ability to work longer hours when necessary and adapt to changing circumstances with ease.
* Proven ability to communicate effectively and work across different cultures and social groups.
* Positive outlook and ability to work well under pressure.
* Commitment to placing clients at the forefront of all interactions, understanding their requirements, and ensuring a positive experience.
* Bachelor's degree in IT/Computing or equivalent work experience.
**Workplace type****:**

On\-site Working **About NTT DATA**  

NTT DATA is a $30\+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune


Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through


responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with


unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and


application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move


confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more


than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as


established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each


year in R\&D.

 **Equal Opportunity Employer**  

NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

 **Third parties fraudulently posing as NTT DATA recruiters**


NTT DATA recruiters will never ask job seekers or candidates for payment or banking information during the recruitment process, for any reason. Please remain vigilant of third parties who may attempt to impersonate NTT DATA recruiters whether in writing or by phone in order to deceptively obtain personal data or money from you. title: HR Business Partner – Talent Acquisition
description:
HR Business Partner – Talent Acquisition \| 2–4 Years

**About the Company**

A fast\-growing organization in the Real Estate sector, focused on building scalable business operations and strengthening its people practices. As the organization continues to grow, the HR function is looking for a Talent Acquisition professional who can take ownership of end\-to\-end hiring while progressively expanding into broader HR Business Partnering responsibilities.

**The Opportunity**

This role is designed for a Talent Acquisition professional who is ready to take the next step in their HR career.

Talent Acquisition will be the core area of responsibility, with the opportunity to work closely with leadership and business stakeholders on manpower planning, talent pipelines, hiring across functions, and strengthening the recruitment process.

Alongside TA, the role will provide hands\-on exposure to broader HR areas including employee engagement, performance management, employee relations, HR operations, and other people initiatives.

The ideal candidate will be hands\-on, proactive, relationship\-oriented, and comfortable owning the recruitment lifecycle independently while developing the business understanding and stakeholder management capabilities required to grow into an HR Business Partner.

**A Note on Where This Role Is Headed**

This role is intended for an HR professional who wants to build a career beyond Talent Acquisition.

The immediate focus will be on building strong ownership of hiring and talent processes. Over time, the role will expand into broader HR Business Partnering, with increasing involvement in employee lifecycle, people processes, manager support, and business\-facing HR initiatives.

As the organization grows, there will be opportunities to take ownership of larger hiring mandates, work more closely with leadership, and contribute to building a scalable HR function.

Key Responsibilities1\. Talent Acquisition \& Hiring — Core Responsibility

* Partner with leadership and hiring managers to understand manpower requirements and translate them into effective hiring plans.
* Own the **end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle**, from sourcing through onboarding.
* Build and maintain talent pipelines across business and support functions.
* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, referrals, agencies, and other relevant channels.
* Screen and assess candidates against role requirements and organizational fit.
* Coordinate interviews and ensure clear communication with candidates and hiring managers throughout the process.
* Manage offer rollouts, negotiations, candidate engagement, and offer\-to\-join conversions.
* Track recruitment progress and proactively address hiring bottlenecks.
* Ensure a positive and consistent candidate experience throughout the hiring journey.
* Maintain recruitment MIS and provide regular updates on hiring metrics, priorities, and progress.
* Support employer branding and initiatives that strengthen the organization's talent pipeline.
* Ensure a smooth joining, onboarding, and induction experience for new hires.

**Key Metrics:** Hiring turnaround time, quality of hire, offer\-to\-join ratio, hiring manager satisfaction, and candidate experience.

2\. HR Business Partnering \& Stakeholder Management

* Act as an HR point of contact for employees and business teams.
* Build strong working relationships with managers and business stakeholders.
* Understand people\-related requirements and provide timely HR support.
* Support managers on employee\-related matters and people decisions.
* Support the implementation of HR processes, policies, and initiatives across the organization.
* Develop a strong understanding of business priorities and their people implications.

3\. Employee Engagement, Performance \& Development

* Support performance management processes, including goal setting, reviews, and continuous feedback.
* Coordinate employee engagement and recognition initiatives.
* Identify learning and development requirements and coordinate relevant interventions.
* Contribute to initiatives that strengthen employee experience and workplace culture.

4\. Employee Relations \& HR Operations

* Support employee relations, grievance handling, and employee communication with maturity and confidentiality.
* Coordinate employee exits, exit interviews, and full and final settlement processes.
* Support payroll inputs, attendance management, employee documentation, and HR administration.
* Maintain accurate employee records and HR databases.
* Track HR metrics and provide relevant insights to leadership.
* Support statutory compliance and ensure required documentation is maintained.

What We’re Looking For

* **2–4 years of experience in Talent Acquisition / Human Resources**, with strong hands\-on recruitment experience.
* Proven experience managing **end\-to\-end hiring independently** across multiple functions and levels.
* Strong sourcing, screening, stakeholder management, interview coordination, and offer negotiation skills.
* Experience in **Real Estate / Construction** is preferred.
* Ability to build and maintain strong candidate pipelines.
* Strong understanding of recruitment metrics and hiring processes.
* Exposure to HR operations, employee relations, performance management, or employee engagement.
* Good understanding of Indian labour laws and basic HR compliance requirements.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and relationship\-building skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and operate effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* MBA in HR is preferred but not mandatory.

**Work Location:** In person

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Sr. Talent Acquisition & Operations
description:
We are looking for a **Sr. Talent Acquisition \& Operations** professional who will be responsible for managing the **end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle for IT and Non\-IT positions**, along with key HR operational activities.

The role will own the recruitment process from **Manpower Requisition and Job Posting through Candidate Sourcing, Screening, Interview Coordination, Selection, Offer Management, Pre\-Joining Formalities, Joining, Onboarding and Induction**, ensuring a smooth and positive candidate and employee experience.

**About Us;**

Beauty Garage Limited is an Indian homegrown company operating in the premium and salon\-grade haircare segment. The company offers professional haircare products and treatment systems catering to luxury and premium salons, beauty professionals, and retail consumers across India.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage **end\-to\-end recruitment for IT \& Non\-IT positions**, from manpower requisition and job posting to candidate sourcing, screening, selection and closure.
* Develop and post **Job Descriptions (JDs)** across relevant job portals, LinkedIn and other sourcing channels.
* Source, screen and shortlist candidates; conduct initial HR discussions and coordinate interview rounds with hiring managers.
* Manage candidate communication, interview scheduling, feedback collection and salary negotiations.
* Prepare and release **offer letters** and ensure effective offer\-to\-joining follow\-up.
* Coordinate **pre\-joining formalities, documentation and background verification**, wherever applicable.
* Manage complete **joining and onboarding process**, including HRMS creation, documentation and coordination with IT, Admin and Accounts.
* Plan and conduct **employee induction**, covering company introduction, HR policies, attendance, leave, benefits, code of conduct and HRMS processes.
* Maintain recruitment trackers, candidate database, hiring MIS and recruitment\-related reports.
* Coordinate with recruitment agencies and other external hiring partners.
* Support **HR Operations and employee lifecycle activities** as required.
* Ensure a smooth and positive **candidate\-to\-employee experience** throughout the recruitment and onboarding journey.

**Key Skills \& Competencies**

* End\-to\-end IT \& Non\-IT Recruitment
* Candidate Sourcing \& Screening
* Interview \& Stakeholder Coordination
* Salary Negotiation \& Offer Management
* Onboarding \& Employee Induction
* Recruitment MIS \& HRMS
* Strong Communication \& Interpersonal Skills
* Time Management \& Multitasking
* Vendor/Agency Management
* Problem\-Solving \& Follow\-up Skills

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce. Specialization in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management or a related field will be an advantage

**Experience**

2–3 years of relevant experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruitment and HR Operations, preferably with experience managing end\-to\-end recruitment for IT and Non\-IT positions.

First preference will be given to candidates nearby residing candidates.

**Candidates can email their profile at careers@beautygarage.com**

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Analyst - Talent Acquisition
description:
**Introduction**  


Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.
  

**Overview**  


We are seeking a dynamic and motivated HR Recruiter to join our Human Resources team. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the full recruitment lifecycle, from sourcing and attracting talent to onboarding new hires. This role requires a proactive approach to identifying and engaging top talent to support the organization's growth and workforce needs.  


  

**How you'll make an impact** **Responsibilities:*** Partner with hiring managers to understand workforce requirements and develop effective recruitment strategies.
* Source, attract, and engage candidates through job boards, social media platforms, networking events, and employee referral programs.
* Review resumes and conduct initial candidate screenings to assess qualifications, skills, and cultural fit.
* Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers and interview panels.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified candidates for current and future hiring needs.
* Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment process.
* Conduct reference checks and background verifications, as required.
* Assist in creating and updating job descriptions and job specifications.
* Stay current with industry trends, labor market developments, and recruitment best practices.
* Support employer branding initiatives to strengthen the organization's reputation as an employer of choice.
* Promote and support diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives within recruitment practices.
* Maintain accurate recruitment records and provide regular hiring updates to stakeholders.

  


  

**About you** **Qualifications:*** Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Proven experience in recruitment, preferably within the insurance or financial services industry.
* Strong knowledge of recruitment processes, sourcing methodologies, and talent acquisition best practices.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team environment.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Familiarity with employment laws, hiring regulations, and compliance requirements.

  


  

**Additional Information**  

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well\-being
* Career development opportunities and ongoing learning
* A collaborative, people\-first culture with accessible leadership
* The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact

**At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace.** If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to join our Talent Community to stay connected to additional career opportunities. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles.*Gallagher is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

**Broadridge Trading \& Connectivity Solutions (BTCS)** is seeking a customer\-focused, technically capable professional to join our Customer Success team. This role is ideal for someone with 3–4 years of experience in the institutional brokerage ecosystem who understands Indian financial markets, trading workflows, and the technology that supports them.


As a **Customer Success Technical Account Manager**, you will serve as a strategic technical partner to clients using Broadridge trading platforms. You will help clients onboard successfully, adopt and optimise platform capabilities, overcome technical challenges, and realise sustained business value from their Broadridge solutions.

**Key** **Responsibilities**

* Build trusted, long\-term relationships with assigned clients and act as their primary technical advisor.
* Develop a strong understanding of each client’s business objectives, operating model, trading workflows, and technical environment.
* Drive adoption, optimisation, and value realisation across Broadridge solutions, identifying opportunities for broader usage and growth.
* Partner with Customer Success Managers and internal stakeholders to develop and execute account success plans aligned to client priorities.
* Identify, manage, and help remove technical barriers that may affect adoption, satisfaction, retention, or operational readiness.
* Advise clients on platform capabilities, integrations, upgrades, solution best practices, and effective usage.
* Monitor technical account health, proactively identifying risks, trends, service\-improvement opportunities, and areas for expansion.
* Lead regular technical account reviews covering platform performance, current initiatives, roadmap alignment, and recommendations.
* Coordinate with Product Delivery, Product Management, Engineering, and Support teams to ensure client requirements are understood and addressed effectively.
* Represent client needs internally by advocating for product enhancements, service improvements, and operational feedback.
* Support key customer lifecycle events, including onboarding, platform upgrades, change events, expansions, and readiness activities.
* Deliver training, enablement sessions, demonstrations, and knowledge\-sharing activities to improve user confidence and adoption.
* Build knowledge of Broadridge products and international financial\-market workflows, including principal and agency trading, equities, derivatives, and FX.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* Minimum 3–4 years of relevant experience in the institutional brokerage ecosystem, including hands\-on support for trading applications.
* Good understanding of Indian financial markets, including NSE/BSE, the regulatory landscape, exchange trading, and the end\-to\-end trade lifecycle.
* Understanding of institutional order\-management workflows, including order entry, modification, cancellation, and execution.
* Familiarity with trading platforms, Order Management Systems (OMS), and/or Execution Management Systems (EMS).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both business and technical stakeholders.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to prioritise effectively in a fast\-paced, time\-sensitive trading environment.

**Preferred Skills \& Experience**

* Experience working with a stockbroker, institutional trading desk, trading technology provider, fintech, or capital\-markets firm.
* Exposure to Indian equities and derivatives markets.
* Familiarity with FIX connectivity and electronic trading workflows.
* Experience using AI and productivity tools to improve documentation, reporting, analysis, and routine operational tasks.


This role offers the opportunity to combine technical expertise, client relationship management, and capital\-markets knowledge to help clients achieve meaningful outcomes while building deep expertise in Broadridge’s trading and connectivity product suite.


We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.

As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)\-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.
